## Description

Splits a large order into displayed child orders while keeping reserve quantity hidden or replenishing it to reduce visible footprint.

## Where it may fit

Large orders in sufficiently deep markets where displayed size would reveal intent and hidden-order support is available.

## Vehicles

Institutional execution, transition management and execution algorithms.

## Required data

Order book depth, trade prints, target quantity, child-order sizing, venue order types, queue position and market-impact estimates.

## Caveats

Venue support and priority treatment differ; iceberg usage can lose queue priority and still incur market impact.
